input.content: Pattern: idempotency/recovery lookup keyed by the wrong field. In an operation keyed by a caller-supplied operation_id, the recovery record was WRITTEN keyed by operation_id (store.recovery[operation_id]=record) but READ by scanning values for a matching workspace (next(item for item in recovery.values() if item["workspace"]==workspace)). Effect: a fresh operation_id for a workspace that already has any record silently reuses the old record — no fresh save, new values dropped, yet ok:True returned (lost update). Rule: look up the recovery/idempotency record by the SAME key it is stored under (the operation id), not by a coarser attribute like workspace. Reconcile write-key and read-key.
